evidence.reason: The finding alleges that the finally block calls `stop`/`archive` without checking results, archiving regardless of stop success, and letting exceptions replace the verdict. The current code at the anchored region already implements the proposed remediation: `stop` is wrapped in try/except recording `stopped` and narrating failures to stderr (lines 94-98); archive runs only when `stopped` is true, with its returncode checked and exceptions caught and narrated (lines 99-104); the not-stopped path emits a stderr warning instead of archiving (lines 105-106). Comments at lines 91-93 state the intended behavior explicitly. Commit 82e1bb01b54dd29c968f751a5c5b70cbcb844901 ("harden driver stops, timeout logs and agent cleanup") introduced this hardening, so the defect is fixed at the tip rather than live.
